body.name: Inverted complete-law confidence set
body.construction: \(\mathcal C_N(\alpha)=\{[h_\vartheta]:\vartheta\in\mathcal M_{n,k,m}(c_0,C_0,K,a_0,J,\Delta_0),\ D_H(\vartheta,\widehat\theta_N)\le c_\alpha\rho_N+\delta_N\}\), where \(c_\alpha\) is calibrated from simultaneous spectral concentration and \(\delta_N\) is the certified sieve and optimization tolerance.
